key_concepts: Heat is energy in transit transferred between objects due to temperature difference
Thermal energy is the energy within a system responsible for its temperature
Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness measured by a thermometer
Heat naturally flows from hotter objects to colder objects
Conduction transfers heat through direct contact and is dominant in solids
Thermal conductors like metals conduct heat well
Thermal insulators like wood, rubber, plastic, glass, and paper conduct heat poorly
Convection transfers heat in fluids through bulk movement caused by temperature difference
Radiation transfers heat by electromagnetic waves without needing a material medium
